LanguageData.FB_BirthPool_Unsealed: The outline is open or has no interior
LanguageData.FB_BirthPool_MapEdge: Move the outline away from the map edge
LanguageData.FB_BirthPool_TooSmall: At least {0} interior cells are required
LanguageData.FB_BirthPool_Overlapping: Pool outlines overlap or are nested
LanguageData.FB_BirthPool_Obstructed: Clear the interior: obstacles, other liquids or foundations
LanguageData.FB_BirthPool_NoSpace: waiting for a free liquid cell
LanguageData.FB_BirthPool_NetworkDetail: Births and regeneration consume hemogel directly from the colony network.
LanguageData.FB_BirthPool_FillDesc: Fill the pool with hemogel or drain it. Filling is free and creates no separate reserve. Births follow growth orders and regeneration is automatic; both consume network hemogel.
LanguageData.FB_BirthPool_CreateAreaDesc: Create an allowed area inside this outline. Assign creatures manually. Repeating this command updates the same area and replaces its previous cells.
LanguageData.FB_BirthPool_AreaCreated: Area "{0}" now matches the interior. Assign creatures to it using their allowed-area settings.
LanguageData.FB_BirthPool_BuildDesc: Grow walkable rims on flesh ground around {0}–{1} clear cells. Select any segment to fill or drain the pool, set shared growth orders, or create an allowed area inside. Births and automatic regeneration consume network hemogel.
